tools.name: contact_b2b
tools.description: Create the recommended contact path for companies interested in certifying collaborators with Prepa IN.

open.description: When true, open the B2B WhatsApp contact link in a new tab. Defaults to false.

tools.name: contact_whatsapp
tools.description: Create a WhatsApp contact link for Prepa IN student or business inquiries, optionally opening it in a new browser tab.

audience.description: Use student for individual enrollment questions or business for company/B2B questions.

message.description: Optional custom WhatsApp message. If omitted, Prepa IN uses a default message for the selected audience.

open.description: When true, open WhatsApp in a new tab. Defaults to false.

tools.name: find_program_info
tools.description: Find structured information and relevant Prepa IN pages for a topic such as cost, requirements, certificate, testimonials, study guides, or companies.

topic.description: Optional topic to focus the result, for example cost, requirements, certificate, testimonials, study guides, enrollment, or business.

tools.name: start_enrollment
tools.description: Prepare the Prepa IN enrollment URL for a prospective student, optionally opening it in a new browser tab.

plan.description: Optional payment or enrollment plan identifier to append to the enrollment URL.

source.description: Optional source label for attribution. Defaults to webmcp.

open.description: When true, open the enrollment page in a new tab. Defaults to false.
